name: Location Category 4 Code
definition: Indicates the type of integration of the POI terminal in the sale environment.

ABRD.name: Aboard
ABRD.definition: Aboard is used when the sale is done in a vehicle (e.g a bus, train, ship, airplane,|taxi, etc).

NMDC.name: Nomadic
NMDC.definition: Nomadic is used when the merchant is traveling to different locations (e.g fair or|sport events, home delivery, food truck).

FIXD.name: Physical Shop
FIXD.definition: Fixed location, for example in a shop.

VIRT.name: Virtual Shop
VIRT.definition: Virtual Shop is used for any ecommerce solution.
